name: L10-PanoLab SEVN 1.0 address-door adapter
question: Can the original SEVN address-linked door annotations and panorama graph instantiate the L10 one-step PAN, SWEEP, APPROACH, SIDESTEP, and HOLD contract without leaking evaluator door truth into runtime observations?

cohort.selection: deterministic address-disjoint rows sorted by street, house number, frame, and annotation x; each start is not CORRECT_UNIQUE and its named recovery action reaches one address-matched door annotation
cohort.development_limit: selection uses SEVN human annotations and is an adapter/mechanism panel, not a held-out model evaluation

action_contract.HOLD: retain the panorama, pose, and 135-degree viewport
action_contract.PAN_LEFT: rotate the SEVN world heading by +67.5 degrees
action_contract.PAN_RIGHT: rotate the SEVN world heading by -67.5 degrees
action_contract.SWEEP: observe four 135-degree viewports separated by 90 degrees on the same panorama
action_contract.APPROACH: move along one frozen SEVN graph edge toward the address-linked goal panorama while retaining the quantized world heading
action_contract.SIDESTEP_LEFT: unavailable no-op because SEVN exposes no lateral-action semantics
action_contract.SIDESTEP_RIGHT: unavailable no-op because SEVN exposes no lateral-action semantics

truth_boundary.public: target address, local camera pose, viewport headings, action graph, and image locator
truth_boundary.evaluator_only: door/text boxes, target visibility, visible-door count, address match count, and binding state
truth_boundary.image_payload: the 1.86 GB low-resolution images.hdf5 is intentionally deferred until metadata admission and replay succeed

successor: download and hash images.hdf5, render the same frozen 24 episodes, and test a pixel-derived target-door proposal without exposing SEVN labels
